added.title: Senior Manager of Software Engineering - Fullstack
added.description:
Job Description

When you mentor and advise multiple technical teams and move financial technologies forward, it's a big challenge with big impact. You were made for this.

As a Senior Manager of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the Global Finance Technology, you serve in a leadership role by providing technical coaching and advisory for multiple technical teams, as well as anticipate the needs and potential dependencies of other functions within the firm. As an expert in your field, your insights influence budget and technical considerations to advance operational efficiencies and functionalities.

Job Responsibilities

Provide overall direction, oversight, and coaching for a team of entry-level to mid-level software engineers that work on basic to moderately complex tasks
Accountable for decisions that influence teams' resources, budget, tactical operations, and the execution and implementation of processes and procedures
Sets and scales operating practices for enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering and SDLC/TLM automation across multiple teams to improve delivery speed, quality, and operational outcomes; establishes measurable expectations (e.g., throughput, defect reduction, reliability) and ensures consistent validation, security, resiliency, and reuse of proven patterns.
Drives adoption and governance of approved AI-assisted engineering practices across teams to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test acceleration, release readiness, incident/root-cause analysis), while establishing measurable validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of proven patterns and automation within the SDLC/TLM toolchain.
Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to drive efficiency and support capacity unlock initiatives across teams, prioritizing reuse of existing firm technology assets.
Leads evaluation sessions with external vendors, startups, and internal teams to drive outcomes-oriented probing of architectural designs, technical credentials, and applicability for use within existing systems and information architecture
Ensures successful collaboration across teams and stakeholders
Identifies and mitigates issues to execute a book of work while escalating issues as necessary
Collaborate with end users and product teams to ensure timely alignment of technical deliverables.
Provides input to leadership regarding budget, approach, and technical considerations to improve operational efficiencies and functionality for the team
Leads communities of practice across Software Engineering to drive awareness and use of new and leading-edge technologies

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience. In addition, 2 + years of experience leading technologists to manage and solve complex technical items within your domain of expertise.
10+ Years of building enterprise grade software products
Expertise in Java, Spring Core, Spring Boot, REST APIs, JPA (OR) Python and relevant microservices framework.
Expertise in JavaScript, Typescript, React and popular test framework for UI
Proficiency in Object-Oriented Design (OOD) and Test Driven Development (TTD), with hands-on experience in test automation frameworks like Junit, Mockito, Playwright and Cucumber.
Strong understanding of security standards such as OAuth, TLS, and Kerberos.
Familiarity with log/metric collection and monitoring technologies like ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, and Splunk.
Proficiency in using Agentic AI Coding assistance such as Copilot, Claude, Windsurf, Gemini.
Experience with event-driven processing using Kafka, and other AMQP framework.
Hands-on experience with building CI/CD pipelines using Git, Maven, Jenkins, SonarQube, and Fortify.
Demonstrated experience leading effective use of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Agile software development experience adhering to a product operating model.
Experience in building enterprise solution focused on Data Analytics will be beneficial
Experience in Finance Reporting will be beneficial
Experience in building cloud-native web applications.
Exposure to NoSQL databases such as Cassandra
Experience in LLM based implementations will be beneficial
Knowledge of Domain Driven Design, microservices patterns, and modern architectures.

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Veterans

About The Team

Our Corporate Technology team relies on smart, driven people like you to develop applications and provide tech support for all our corporate functions across our network. Your efforts will touch lives all over the financial spectrum and across all our divisions: Global Finance, Corporate Treasury, Risk Management, Human Resources, Compliance, Legal, and within the Corporate Administrative Office. You'll be part of a team specifically built to meet and exceed our evolving technology needs, as well as our technology controls agenda.

added.title: New Ventures Technology & Innovation | Strategy & Operations | Associate Firm Director, Strategic Initiatives
added.description:
New Ventures Technology & Innovation | Firm Associate Director Strategy, Growth and Transformation

The Associate Director, Strategic Initiatives supports the Strategic Initiatives Leader in advancing NVTI's highest-priority programs, serving as a trusted thought partner and execution backbone across a portfolio that spans product governance, strategic external partnerships, and firm-level cross-functional initiatives.

The role requires substantive understanding of product strategy and lifecycle, including familiarity with product governance frameworks, platform-to-product models, and investment prioritization. It also requires the organizational fluency to navigate Deloitte's matrixed environment across businesses, enabling functions, and Global, building credibility and momentum with senior stakeholders without direct authority.

This role is designed for a leader who can move fluidly between strategic framing and operational execution: distilling complexity into clarity, preparing senior-leader decision materials, tracking progress across concurrent workstreams, identifying risks, and proactively course-correcting to sustain pace and quality across the portfolio.

Estimated Date of Closure September 8, 2026

Work you'll do

Strategic Program Execution

Portfolio Management
Track progress across multiple concurrent NVTI workstreams and maintain visibility into priorities, dependencies, and decision points.
Identify execution risks, surface tradeoffs, and proactively course-correct to keep initiatives moving.
Create operating discipline across workstreams through clear planning, follow-up, and accountability routines.

Senior Leader Support
Prepare materials that enable senior-leader decision-making, including structured briefings, options, recommendations, and status updates.
Distill complex product, partnership, and governance topics into clear, executive-ready narratives.
Represent the Strategic Initiatives Leader in working sessions and stakeholder engagements with confidence and discretion.

Product Governance & Investment Prioritization

Product Strategy
Support work related to product strategy, lifecycle management, and platform-to-product models.
Help translate product governance concepts into practical operating mechanisms and decision forums.
Contribute to investment prioritization discussions by organizing inputs, clarifying choices, and documenting rationale.

Governance Discipline
Maintain clarity on governance cadence, required decisions, owners, and follow-through.
Ensure materials and discussions connect strategic objectives to execution implications.

Stakeholder Engagement & Matrixed Influence

Cross-Functional Alignment
Operate across businesses, enabling functions, and Global to build alignment around shared priorities.
Develop credibility with senior stakeholders by bringing structured thinking, follow-through, and sound judgment.
Help translate stakeholder input into practical next steps, decision pathways, and communications.

Communication
Communicate with clarity, discretion, and appropriate altitude across all levels of the organization.
Balance strategic context with operational specificity so stakeholders understand both the "why" and the "what next."

The successful candidate would possess these skills

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

New Ventures, Technology, and Innovation (NVTI) is a unique team in Enterprise Solutions. Its focus is to rapidly identify, shape, experiment and incubate new business opportunities that leverage leading edge technologies. Our team is focused on the impacts that strategy, innovation, and technology advances are having on Deloitte's marketplace offerings and internal operations. Deloitte's breadth, depth, and scale, combined with our relentless passion for innovation create powerful opportunities to help our clients and our own organization stay ahead of change, deliver impact that matters, and transform complexity and disruption into lasting value.

Qualifications

Required Experience:

Bachelor's degree
10+ years of relevant experience in management consulting, strategic initiatives, business transformation, go-to-market strategy, product or asset strategy, or a related business-focused discipline within a complex organization.
2+ years of experience managing people and/or business processes, including setting priorities, assigning work, establishing operating routines, coaching team members, and monitoring quality and outcomes.
Prior experience leading ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution, including defining objectives and scope, structuring work, aligning stakeholders without direct authority, managing dependencies and risks, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

Preferred Experience:

Prior experience navigating Deloitte's matrixed organization or a comparable global professional services environment, including collaboration across businesses, enabling functions, and Global to build alignment and advance priorities.
Prior experience taking consulting products, assets, packaged offerings, or accelerators to market alongside consulting services, including developing go-to-market plans, defining commercial models, evaluating investment or funding needs, and measuring expected ROI.
Prior experience developing and executing business-side product or asset strategies, including lifecycle planning, governance, investment prioritization, strategic partnerships, new venture development, market entry, and scaling offerings for internal or external clients.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $151,400 to $278,900

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

added.title: Director, Global Workplace Design
added.description:
Job Requisition ID JR2025017

Job Category Facilities

Time Type Full time

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We're seeking a Global Workplace Design Director to serve as a senior leader within NVIDIA's Real Estate & Site Services (RESS) team, directing architectural, interior, furniture, and finish selections across all workplace and campus developments worldwide. This role is uniquely placed to lead creation and partner with multi-functional teams and senior RESS leadership to deliver workplaces that reflect NVIDIA's culture and operational demands globally—ensuring design consistency from concept through delivery.

What You'll Be Doing

Drive unified development standards across Architecture, Interior Design, Furniture, and Finishes globally, ensuring every project reflects a cohesive NVIDIA design language.
Provide leadership in building solutions for Campus Projects, Tenant Improvement Projects, and Datacenter Office Projects worldwide.
Serve as the lead creative voice across Architecture, Interior Design, Furniture, and Finishes for all campus, tenant improvement, and datacenter office projects—guiding and uniting collaborators around a clear development vision.
Lead NVIDIA's workplace build experimentation strategy: identify emerging trends and end-user needs, build and drive pilot programs to test new concepts, and define evaluation criteria for success.
Assist regional leaders on pre-lease feasibility studies and general build issues. Lead initial new site visits and site studies for potential locations globally.
Provide strategic mentorship to regional occupancy planners, facility managers, and office managers on architectural planning decisions.
Coordinate review of architectural drawings and design documentation for campus projects to ensure alignment with NVIDIA Workplace Guidelines.
Serve as the main lead and creative contact for all external architecture, interior development, furniture, and finishes partners worldwide—shaping creative intent and reviewing concepts and specifications.
Coordinate budget planning and expenditure on design globally; assess budget constraints and define priorities for value engineering on design and FF&E.

What We Need To See

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in interior design or architecture from an accredited institution; advanced degree preferred.
15+ overall years of professional experience in corporate workplace development.
5+ years in a senior leadership or director-level role.
Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or Revit and Bluebeam.
Comprehensive understanding of building codes, accessibility requirements, and workplace safety standards across multiple global regions.
Proven ability to lead multiple large-scale, concurrent projects across geographies with competing priorities and deadlines.
Willingness and ability to travel to NVIDIA office sites in the regions.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience leading in-house global workplace build functions at a high-tech company or within a corporate real estate organization in the technology sector.
Well-rounded knowledge of foreign geography, cultures, practices, and markets.
Experienced with the build of technical labs and specialized research environments.
Deep expertise in hybrid work models, campus development strategy, and next-generation workplace innovations.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 232,000 USD - 356,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 7, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

added.title: Senior Manager, WWEI Supply Chain Engineering
added.description:
Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Manager to join our Supply Chain team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in driving the process engineering initiatives of Amazon Logistics delivery stations across North America and Europe. You will collaborate closely with our engineering team for new product development, identify and select strategic suppliers, lead complex negotiations, and ensure seamless project from technology proof of concept development to scale up strategy and execution. In addition, will be responsible for developing and scaling the global Contract Manufacturing workstream across all Engineering initiatives.

Key job responsibilities

Supplier Selection And Qualification

Identify and evaluate potential suppliers based on capabilities, cost-effectiveness, and reliability.
Lead the negotiation process to secure favorable terms and conditions for our organization.
Conduct rigorous supplier qualification processes to assess their ability to meet our quality, delivery, and performance standards.

Project Execution

Develop and implement comprehensive project plans to ensure timely and efficient execution.
Monitor project progress, identify potential risks, and take proactive measures to mitigate them.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project stays on track.

Supply Chain Optimization

Continuously analyze supply chain processes to identify opportunities for improvement and cost reduction.
Develop and Implement strategies to scale up the technologies across regions with qualified suppliers
Develop and maintain strong relationships with suppliers to foster collaboration and address any issues promptly.

Risk Management

Identify and assess potential supply chain risks, such as supplier disruptions, quality issues, or geopolitical factors.
Develop and implement contingency plans to minimize the impact of these risks.

A day in the life

The Supply Chain team owns the supply chain set-up and readiness for all new programs and products across multiple engineering categories (equipment, fixtures consumables etc.). We bring last & middle mile's ambitious goals to life by partnering with a wide set of stakeholders in Worldwide Engineering, WHS, Design, Operations and Procurement. We program manage vendors during the design, deployment, and change management stages. We partner internally and externally to deliver program milestones, cost, quality and sustainability.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of managing procurement teams with direct experience in supplier/supply chain experience
Experience in strategic sourcing for high tech electronics/computing/communications fields
Experience in supply chain such as contracting, demand management and/or planning and procurement, and supply chain operations
Experience managing procurement teams with direct experience in supplier/supply chain management

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management
